recentItems.title: Santa's Rockin' Workshop, arr. Chris M. Bernotas – Score & Sound
recentItems.description:
For more information, or to purchase, go to www.alfred.com.

Santa's Rockin' Workshop
(Featuring Up on the Housetop, Angels We Have Heard on High, and Auld Lang Syne)
Traditional, arr. Chris M. Bernotas (ASCAP)
00-50386
Sound Innovations Series for Band
Grade: 0.5
Santa's Rockin' Workshop, arranged by Chris M. Bernotas, is all ready for your student's very first performance. It uses only the first six notes of the Bb scale, has two dynamic markings, one articulation, no key signature, and no slurs. It does have the holiday classics: "Up on the Housetop," "Angels We Have Heard on High," and a taste of "Auld Lang Syne." There is even a terrific part for cowbell, because every holiday tune should have cowbell!

recentItems.description:
For more information, or to purchase, go to https://bit.ly/41TGdHO.

Bright Horizon (March)
By Scott Watson (BMI)
00-50387
Sound Innovations Series for Band
Grade: 1
Bright Horizon March, by Scott Watson, is an energetic concert march written especially for young band. With its spirited tempo, clear melodies, and confident rhythms, the piece evokes a sense of optimism for students at the start of their musical journey. Carefully scored to support developing players, the piece reinforces essential skills and basic march form while delivering an uplifting and rewarding musical experience as your students march forward in band!

Foothill March
By JaRod Hall
00-52096
MakeMusic Young Band
Grade: 2.5
Inspired by the rolling fields at the base of the Appalachian mountains, Foothill March is a tuneful work in 6/8 and is a highly approachable introduction to compound meter. As the work develops, JaRod Hall takes the listener through a variety of textures, styles, and ever-changing harmonies. Highly engaging and outside the box! (2:15)

Luminance
By JaRod Hall
00-52089
MakeMusic Symphonic Band
Grade: 4
Honor a life well-lived with Luminance, a moving tribute to a beloved band director. JaRod Hall's music is a powerful coexistence of grief and celebration, featuring a rich, expressive harmonic language and unique textures. Highlights include stunning color changes throughout, as well as harmonies inspired by Gospel music. Stunning. (4:45)

Chaos Agent
By Tanner Walterman
00-51989
MakeMusic Symphonic Band
Grade: 4
Chaos Agent is a lively, yet frantic journey inspired by uncontrolled chaos surrounding the listener. Playful melodies are juxtaposed with intense rhythmic and harmonic elements, all washed in a sea of changing colors. Ideal as an energetic opener or firey closer, this is a fabulous work by Tanner Walterman, a fresh, young voice! (3:30)

recentItems.description:

Winter Song
By Kenley Kristofferson (SOCAN)
00-50431
Belwin Beginning Band
Grade: 1
Winter Song, by Kenley Kristofferson, is a wistful and expressive ballad portraying the serenity and beauty of winter. The piece's lilting melody in 3/4, shared by many instruments throughout the ensemble, makes it a great first ballad for beginning bands and gives the ensemble a great opportunity to explore lyrical playing. It features four percussion parts and an optional vibraphone part, giving the music that extra wintery sparkle!

Sims is one blizzard adventure that will have students excited about coming to school! (1:30)

Suite from The Planets
By Gustav Holst, arr. Michael Story
00-50427
Belwin Beginning Band
Grade: 1.5
Gustav Holst's masterwork The Planets is the basis for this mini-suite containing music from three of the movements. Varied styles, textures, and dynamics make this piece educationally sound for your beginning band, and it also serves as an excellent introduction to one of the most important works of the 20th century.

recentItems.description:
For more information, or to purchase, go to https://bit.ly/4vl9LvG.

Tambourin
By Michael Oare
00-50436
Belwin Young Band
Grade: 2
Tambourin, by Michael Oare, draws inspiration from a traditional French dance and the distinctive sound of the tambourin-- a low-pitched drum from the Provence region. This vibrant piece captures the lively duple meter and rhythmic drive of the dance, featuring an energetic, memorable melody and a contrasting lyrical section in the parallel minor key. With colorful orchestration and engaging material for every section, Tambourin is both educational and rewarding to perform, making it an ideal concert or contest selection.

recentItems.description:
For more information, or to purchase, go to https://bit.ly/4vhCaTi.

Snowdance
By Robert Buckley (SOCAN)
00-50439
Belwin Young Band
Grade: 2
Snowdance, by Robert Buckley, is a festive holiday overture for young band. Sparkling with bright, celebratory energy, the piece opens with tuneful melodies and lively rhythms before moving into a more reflective middle section. Dynamic contrasts and shifting textures keep the music fresh and engaging, giving every section of the band a chance to shine. Building toward a joyful, triumphant finish, Snowdance captures the excitement and warmth of the season while sounding far more sophisticated than its grade level suggests.

recentItems.description:
For more information, or to purchase, go to https://bit.ly/3Ox4T61.

At Fate's Door
By JaRod Hall
00-52093
MakeMusic Young Band
Grade: 2.5
Dare to knock? Inspired by a chilling true story, At Fate's Door is a cinematic work by JaRod Hall who uses percussive rim-knocks and siren-like woodwinds to explore the horror behind a closed door. From haunting, downward melodies to a heart-pounding climax, your ensemble will leave the audience breathless, wondering if they truly escaped the darkness within. (3:00)
